description: The run as plain text on every tier: every step with its mark, who answered it, the notes, the counts and a signature block or the recorded signature. Pro also writes it to out_path as a .txt file.

out_path.description: Where to write the .txt file. Pro only. Omit to get the report back as text, which every tier can do

overwrite.description: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false, and an existing file is refused with nothing written

run.description: The run id, e.g. RUN-2026-0001, or its title when only one carries it

name: run_report
title: Produce the run report
